reviews.author: Towermagi
reviews.title: Scammy company
reviews.content: This whole system/company feels like a SCAM for anyone NOT a citizen or permanent resident of Mainland China. They offer travelers a Travel Pass for people who are visiting China but then after depositing money into Travel Pass they lock your account and claim they need to verify your identity and can only do so with a Mainland China bank card. Well, guess what? You can’t get a Mainland Chinese bank card without being a citizen or permanent resident. So much for Travel Pass working for travelers who aren’t either. Customer service is an absolute joke. I have tried the US support number (it’s always voicemail, I left several A MONTH ago, not holding my breath on a response), the Chinese support number is “no longer in service”, I have sent several emails and I have even tried Facebook. I have never encountered a company of this supposed size that is so unprofessional bordering on fraudulent. In fact this whole system appears to be one giant scam because they claim Travel Pass is for foreigners to China but then require citizen status (only after they have taken your money). Here is what happened to me: They let me register for the app with my US debit card. Everything went through perfectly fine, the app even said I can use my US debit card to verify my identity. I then put 500RMB into my Travel Pass account. Then the next day, when I tried to launch the app, they claimed they needed to reverify my identity. I put in my US debit card again and got the message that they cannot accept that card as verification. So my card was good enough to let me register and then deduct money from, but once they’ve taken the money, my card is no longer good for verification? Sounds like a SCAM to me. Check Facebook, I’m not the only one that fell for this scam, there are a ton of people on there with their money taken and then unable to reverify. I will be filing a complaint for this company with the Apple app store because they should not be allowed to be on here.

version_plan.rationale: High impact: many international users face critical verification and usability issues, blocking access to funds and core features. Feasibility: improvements to verification flows and international support are achievable with focused engineering effort.

Users consistently complain about app bloat, unnecessary features, and performance degradation. Streamlining the app and optimizing performance will improve user satisfaction and retention with moderate effort.

Excessive ads and promotional content are a major source of frustration. Reducing intrusive ads and giving users more control can be implemented with moderate effort and high impact on user experience.

Account suspensions, security concerns, and perceived fraud severely damage trust. Addressing these issues is critical for long-term retention and requires coordinated efforts across support, security, and communication.
Poor translation and incomplete localization hinder non-Chinese users. Improving language support and localization is a high-impact, medium-effort task that broadens the app's accessibility.

Lack of support for international payment methods and WeChat Pay integration limits usability for many users. Expanding payment options is a high-impact feature that requires partnerships and technical integration.
Users find the interface complicated and cluttered. Simplifying the UI and clarifying the app's core purpose will improve usability and reduce confusion, with moderate effort.
Dark mode inconsistencies and unappealing app icon design are common complaints. Improving visual consistency and aesthetics is a relatively low-effort, high-satisfaction update.
System errors, crashes, and glitches disrupt usage. Prioritizing stability and bug fixes is essential for maintaining a reliable app, though it may require ongoing effort.
Users are unhappy with forced features, aggressive prompts, and lack of control over updates. Giving users more control and refining features will improve satisfaction and trust.

acceptance_criteria: Verification process completes without server busy errors in 95% of attempts.
Users receive clear, actionable error messages when verification fails.
Account restrictions due to verification issues are reduced by 50%.

requirements.description: Simplify the identity verification flow by improving passport chip scanning, reducing repeated ID uploads, and enhancing facial recognition accuracy. Provide step-by-step instructions and real-time feedback to help users complete verification successfully.
acceptance_criteria: Passport chip scanning succeeds on the first attempt for 90% of users.
Users can complete identity verification without needing to re-upload documents more than once.
Facial recognition errors are reduced by 40%.

requirements.title: Enhance international registration and functionality
requirements.description: Improve registration and verification for international users, especially those outside China, by addressing passport verification failures and SMS issues. Ensure the app functions reliably across different regions and network conditions.
acceptance_criteria: International users can register and verify accounts without passport verification failures.
SMS verification works reliably for international phone numbers.
App functionality remains stable for users in different countries.

requirements.title: Support foreign bank cards for international users
requirements.description: Enable foreign users, particularly from the US, to add and use foreign bank cards for payments and verification. Remove the requirement for a Chinese bank card and prevent account lockouts for international users.
acceptance_criteria: Foreign bank cards can be added successfully without errors.
International users can complete verification without a Chinese bank card.
Account lockouts for foreign users are reduced by 60%.

requirements.title: Remove or hide non-payment AI features

A settings toggle allows users to enable or disable AI features.
App launch time improves by at least 20% after disabling AI features.

Frame rate stays above 30 fps during scrolling and transitions.
CPU usage drops by at least 15% during idle state.

requirements.title: Reduce app storage footprint and declutter interface
